description.en: The ID of the cloud-native API gateway.

description.zh: 网关类型过滤，目前支持**AI**、**API**两种网关类型。
description.en: The gateway type filter. Valid values: **AI** and **API**.

description.zh: 搜索关键词，支持API名称模糊搜索或API ID精确搜索。
description.en: The search keyword. Supports fuzzy match by API name or exact search by API ID.
The exact name to search for.

description.zh: 分页页码，从1开始，不填默认1.
description.en: The page number, starting from 1. Default value: 1.

description.zh: 分页大小，有效范围[1, 100]，不填默认10。
description.en: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.
The ID of the resource group.

description.zh:
HTTP API的类型。支持传入多个类型，采用","分割。
- Http
- Rest
- WebSocket
- HttpIngress
description.en:
The type of the HTTP API. You can specify multiple types separated by commas (,). Valid values:
- Http
- Rest
- WebSocket
- HttpIngress

description.zh: 是否返回已发布到指定环境的API信息
description.en: Specifies whether to return information about APIs published to the specified environment.

description.zh: 响应中每个API信息携带指定环境ID下的消费者认证策略信息。
description.en: The environment ID. If specified, the response includes consumer authentication policy information for each API in the specified environment.

description.zh: 是否开启了权限认证策略
description.en: Specifies whether authentication policies are enabled.

description.zh: 响应中每个API信息携带指定消费者ID的授权规则列表。
description.en: The consumer ID. If specified, the response includes the authorization rule list for the specified consumer for each API.
Specifies whether to include ingress information.

description.zh: 插件ID，根据此插件ID获取插件发布信息。
description.en: The plug-in ID. If specified, the response includes the plug-in publishing information for the specified plug-in.
Specifies whether to include policy information.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun apig list-http-apis --keyword test- --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --name login --types Http,Rest --gateway-id gw-cq2avtllh0000 --with-auth-policy-in-environment-id env-xxx --with-consumer-info-by-id cs-xxx --with-environment-info true --with-plugin-attachment-by-plugin-id pl-ct9qn3um1hktue8dqol0 --resource-group-id rg-ahr5uil8raz0rq3b --with-environment-info-by-id env-ctovu5mm1hksb4q8ln40 --with-auth-policy-list true --with-ingress-info false --with-policy-configs false --with-ap-is-published-to-environment true --gateway-type API --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun apig GET /v1/http-apis --region cn-hangzhou --types 'Http,Rest' --pageNumber 1 --withIngressInfo false --withAuthPolicyList true --withEnvironmentInfo true --withPluginAttachmentByPluginId 'pl-ct9qn3um1hktue8dqol0' --pageSize 10 --withAPIsPublishedToEnvironment true --withPolicyConfigs false --withAuthPolicyInEnvironmentId 'env-xxx' --gatewayType API --withEnvironmentInfoById 'env-ctovu5mm1hksb4q8ln40' --name login --resourceGroupId 'rg-ahr5uil8raz0rq3b' --keyword 'test-' --gatewayId 'gw-cq2avtllh0000' --withConsumerInfoById 'cs-xxx' --header "Content-Type=application/json"
